about_the_game:
"Secret of Havendor" is a narrative-driven fantasy RPG where your decisions shape the path of a broken man. Step into the role of Mark, a young man who fled his hometown where he faced lifelong scorn, only to find himself in the enigmatic city of Havendor. Yet greater trials await him here. Haunted by memories of shame, he enters a world where violence is currency and trust is a luxury. Will Mark become a victim of circumstance, or will he find the strength to change his destiny?

Key Features:

🔹 Fateful Choices: Make difficult, irreversible decisions at every turn. Will you walk the path of vengeance and power, or choose mercy at great personal risk? Every choice transforms Mark and the world around him.
🔹 Atmospheric World of Havendor: Explore grim alleyways, ancient ruins, and perilous forests. From rumor-filled taverns to cursed towers—every corner of this world breathes mystery and danger.
🔹 Tactical Combat & Puzzles: Battle creatures and dangerous foes using mastered skills. Solve intricate puzzles in ancient ruins to uncover the world’s secrets.

What Awaits Players:

  • Dynamic Relationships: Your actions directly impact how other characters perceive you. Aid or betrayal, loyalty or calculation—every decision carries consequences.

  • Exploration & Unraveling Mysteries: Hunt for hidden journals, decipher ancient symbols, heed city rumors, and confront unexplainable forces to understand this world’s true nature.

"The only thing sharper than your blade is the truth you’re afraid to face."
